sourceArtifactsKnownBeforeFreeze: S12 frozen causal estimands, effects, diagnostics, and sensitivity results
S13 frozen counterexample-search design, bounded-null classification, and brittle E06 instances
prohibitedChanges: No mechanism variable, endpoint orientation, objective, weight, uncertainty rule, or claim rule may be changed after S14 synthesis outcomes are inspected.
No exploratory S06 or S13 candidate may be promoted into the protected confirmatory population.
No S13 bounded null may be described as global absence.
No associational modifier or sampled-design variance component may be described as a causal effect.

frozenContrasts.mechanism: matched topology under the no-fault parity contract
frozenContrasts.evidence: S10 parity negative control and S02 interface validation

frozenContrasts.mechanism: stop versus skip continuation after stuck faults
passive versus stuck mobility faults under stop continuation

mechanismMap.modifierInterpretation: Associational heterogeneity inside the exact simulated S11 support; no extrapolation and no causal modifier attribution.
mechanismMap.displayRule: Display raw effect, benefit-oriented effect, bootstrap interval, and effect divided by the frozen practical margin. Include every supported S12 modifier cell without outcome-based selection.

pareto.analysisPopulation: All 2,000 protected S11 pairing blocks and all six executable treatment settings; no run exclusion.
pareto.frontierRule: The primary Pareto frontier is unweighted and uses the three raw population means. A setting dominates another only when it is no worse on every objective and strictly better on at least one.
pareto.weightNormalization: Within each bootstrap draw, min-max normalize every objective across the six settings; a zero-range objective contributes zero. Smaller weighted score is better.
pareto.costSensitivityRule: Recompute unweighted frontier and bootstrap inclusion probabilities for each cost definition. Weighted scalarizations are primary-S01 only.

uncertainty.method: paired scale-stratified nonparametric bootstrap over pairing blocks with common resamples across all six settings

varianceDecomposition.estimand: Descriptive share of total run-level outcome variance in the empirical S10 sampled design, partitioned into between-pairing-block context, exact hierarchical Shapley treatment-group contributions within block, and unexplained within-block residual.
varianceDecomposition.sampledDesignBoundary: Exactly 250 complete S10 screening pairing blocks crossed with the 14 frozen treatment signatures (3,500 runs). Fractions describe this sampled screening design only and are neither population-general nor causal.
varianceDecomposition.hierarchyRule: An interaction design block is admitted only when the interaction group and every corresponding parent main-effect group are present in the coalition. The topology/coordination group jointly represents architecture and the frozen weak-coordinator intervention state.

uncertainty.method: scale-stratified cluster bootstrap over the 250 pairing blocks

s13Sensitivity.inclusionRule: Include all eight independently confirmed S13 candidates and the frozen detection-limit summary.
s13Sensitivity.claimRule: Report zero fully confirmed counterexamples in the finite searched-and-confirmed region; label the two E06 exact-instance reversals as brittle because neighborhood confirmation and directional-concordance thresholds failed. Never infer global absence.

claimRules.causalRule: Only randomized S11/S12 active-versus-reference contrasts may carry causal language, and only on the exact simulated support and frozen estimands.
claimRules.heterogeneityRule: Modifier maps, variance shares, and empirical Pareto rankings are descriptive or associational; they do not identify causal modifier effects.
claimRules.rngRule: E03 and E06 remain RNG-unpaired. Their task contrasts retain the S12 interpretation, while cost contrasts must display the independent-arm sensitivity caveat.
claimRules.resourceRule: E04 must be represented as a task-versus-resource tradeoff and not as an unqualified winner.
claimRules.nullRule: Near-null, equivalence, and bounded-search results may not be converted into proof of exact equality or global absence.
claimRules.supportRule: No extrapolation outside the S11/S12 simulated scales, structures, policies, directions, placements, and fault counts.

releaseAndBundle.sourceArchivePolicy: Repository source remains in Git. Create an explicit NOT_CREATED metadata file instead of copying repository source into artifacts.
requiredReleaseChecks: repository test suite relevant to S14
